metadata.title: From veering triangulations to convergence actions and back again
metadata.abstract: Suppose that $M$ is a finite-volume cusped hyperbolic three-manifold, equipped with a veering triangulation $\mathcal{V}$. We prove that the action of the fundamental group of $M$ on the veering two-sphere is a geometrically finite convergence action. Applying a result of Yaman, we deduce that the veering two-sphere is equivariantly homeomorphic to the boundary of hyperbolic space. As an application, we obtain Cannon-Thurston maps associated to veering triangulations. If $\mathcal{V}$ is layered we recover the classical Cannon-Thurston map. If it is not we obtain Cannon-Thurston maps that do not come from surface subgroups. These are the first such examples in the cusped case. Finally, we implement an algorithm to draw approximations of these Cannon-Thurston maps. This improves upon previous approximations obtained by Thurston and others.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 对带 veering 三角剖分的有限体积尖点双曲三维流形，构造群作用的 veering 球面并识别其边界。
analysis.breakthrough: 得到超出分层及曲面子群来源的新型尖点 Cannon–Thurston 映射。
analysis.limitations: 依赖 veering 三角剖分和有限体积尖点背景，不能直接推广到任意三维流形。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。未见 AI 协作声明仅指这些已检查来源，不代表已核验整篇论文完全由人类完成。
analysis.priorityReason: 群边界、双曲几何与组合三角剖分的结合具有较强结构意义。
